variants.prompt: An extreme close-up captures a striking young woman with rich chestnut hair, her bright emerald eyes half-lidded and sultry as she gazes directly into the camera lens. Her porcelain skin glows under soft, golden light. Her lips, painted a deep, berry red, are parted slightly, inviting. A delicate silver Celtic necklace glimmers at her throat, drawing the eye to her creamy décolletage. The shallow depth of field blurs the background, emphasizing her captivating face and sensuous allure.
